data.summary:
As the battle begins, you can place this unit's Teleport Homer token anywhere outside the deployment zone of your opponent.

Once per battle, if you placed the token, the **[Rapid Ingress](vsdata:ability/core.rapid-ingress)** Stratagem can target this unit for 0CP. As that Stratagem resolves, this unit must be placed up to 3" from the token and more than 8" from every enemy model, then the token is removed.
